scope: Relevant official text sections only; no complete video viewing, native build, APNs/Web Push delivery or physical device test

sources.read: Home Screen Web Push permission, paired Watch, Focus sections
sources.finding: iOS16.4+ Home Screen web apps can request Web Push after a user gesture; permitted notifications can appear on paired Watch.

sources.read: iPhone lock/Watch lock routing and mirrored notification settings
sources.finding: Routing depends on iPhone/Watch state and settings.
Haptic alerts can be off/default/prominent; website cannot guarantee a specific vibration.

sources.read: Transcript data model, WidgetKit widget extension/SwiftUI views and cross-device presentations
sources.finding: Native ActivityKit/WidgetKit implementation for Lock Screen/Dynamic Island; current PWA has no such target.
iOS/iPadOS26 AlarmKit alarms/countdowns, paired Watch alert and Live Activity countdown; per-app opt-in; alarms can break silent mode/Focus.
Service worker lifetime is event-bound; browser can terminate when idle or over imposed event execution limits.

sources.read: Controlled multiple/order/compose controls/keyboard/transition sections; installed9.6.3 Accordion/Panel types and runtime keepMounted behavior
sources.finding: Native button semantics, no nested interactive controls; keepMounted/display-none retains failed input draft.

inference: Timer-completion push needs server scheduling plus cancellation/version control; browser JS waiting is not a dependable background alarm. Native AlarmKit+Live Activity is a promising P2 option, not an implemented feature. Native local notification is an alternative for gentle alerts.
